---
name: visual-design
description: Refine the typography, career timeline, and accessibility of Manivannan Kalyanasundaram's personal portfolio while preserving its visual system.
---

Read AGENTS.md and inspect the current layouts and global stylesheet. This is a personal portfolio with a career timeline, not a research organization. Preserve the white background, charcoal text (#262626), cobalt blue accents (#2A48E8), large personal name, serif accents, generous whitespace, and quiet navigation unless the user requests a new direction.

Make design choices serve reading: clear hierarchy, comfortable line lengths, meaningful labels, visible focus, and sufficient contrast. Avoid decorative dashboards, stock imagery, and animation without a reading-related purpose. Do not invent articles or research to fill the layout.

Check narrow mobile and wide desktop layouts, long titles, empty lists, keyboard navigation, and article typography. Preserve the repository base path in links. Build the site and report any browser verification that could not be completed.
